title: Functions On The Segments
statementMd:
You have an array $*f*$ of $*n*$ functions.The function $*f*_{*i*}(*x*)$ ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$) is characterized by parameters: $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{1}, *a*, *b*, *y*_{2}$ and take values:

- $*y*_{1}$, if $*x* ≤ *x*_{1}$.
- $*a*·*x* + *b*$, if $*x*_{1} < *x* ≤ *x*_{2}$.
- $*y*_{2}$, if $*x* > *x*_{2}$.

There are $*m*$ queries. Each query is determined by numbers $*l*$, $*r*$ and $*x*$. For a query with number $*i*$ ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *m*$), you need to calculate the sum of all $*f*_{*j*}(*x*_{*i*})$ where $*l* ≤ *j* ≤ *r*$. The value of $*x*_{*i*}$ is calculated as follows: $*x*_{*i*} = (*x* + *last*)$ mod $10^{9}$, where $*last*$ is the answer to the query with number $*i* - 1$. The value of $*last*$ equals $0$ if $*i* = 1$.

## Input

First line contains one integer number $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 75000$).

Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains six integer numbers: $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{1}, *a*, *b*, *y*_{2}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{1} < *x*_{2} ≤ 2·10^{5}$, $0 ≤ *y*_{1}, *y*_{2} ≤ 10^{9}$, $0 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{4}$).

Next line contains one integer number $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 500000$).

Each of the next $*m*$ lines contains three integer numbers: $*l*$, $*r*$ and $*x*$ ($1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$, $0 ≤ *x* ≤ 10^{9}$).
